name: Corporate Action Cash Movements 2
definition: Provides information about the cash movement resulting from the election instruction.

PostingIdentification.name: Posting Identification
PostingIdentification.definition: Posting identification of the cash movement.

PostingDateTime.name: Posting Date Time
PostingDateTime.definition: Posting date of the cash movement.

PostingAmount.name: Posting Amount
PostingAmount.definition: Amount posted as a result of the cash movement.

AccountDetails.name: Account Details
AccountDetails.definition: Provides information about the account which is debited/credited as a result of the movement.
